rows.source: Give him oral rehydration solution after every loose stool.
rows.translation: Mpe dawa ya kumuongezea maji kinywani kila anapopata kinyesi.
rows.back_translation: Give him a mouthwash every time he has a bowel movement.

rows.source: After every loose stool, give him ORS to drink.
rows.translation: Kila anapopata kinyesi kizito, mpe ORS anywe.
rows.back_translation: Whenever he has a heavy stool, give him ORS to drink.
